tools.name: droplink_publish_document
tools.description: Publish a Markdown report or CSV table as a readable, publicly shareable page for 24 hours. Returns a private deletion token only once. Scripts, images, and embeds are removed. Limits: 80,000 bytes, 500 CSV rows, 30 columns.

tools.name: droplink_read_document
tools.description: Read a published DropLink document and its expiry. Expired links return 404.

tools.name: droplink_delete_document
tools.description: Delete a published DropLink immediately using its private deletion token.

tools.name: hookbox_create_inbox
tools.description: Create a 24-hour webhook inbox with independent incoming and private reading capabilities. Accepts 100 events up to 16 KB each.

tools.name: hookbox_read_inbox
tools.description: Read a webhook inbox using its private read token.

tools.name: hookbox_delete_inbox
tools.description: Delete a webhook inbox and all its stored events.

tools.name: chartlink_create_chart
tools.description: Create a bar, line, or stacked bar chart from numbers. Returns SVG and PNG files plus a hosted result for 24 hours.

tools.name: chartlink_get_chart
tools.description: Retrieve a chart and download URLs before its 24-hour expiry.

tools.name: cleanread_read_page
tools.description: Extract readable text, Markdown, headings, HTTP links, and tables from one accessible public webpage. Does not execute JavaScript or bypass access restrictions.

tools.name: sourcecheck_check_sources
tools.description: Check up to ten public source URLs for successful HTTP responses, final URLs, titles, and optional quotation matches in fetched text. Reports blocked and unreadable sources honestly. Does not verify factual truth.

tools.name: printkit_create_pdf
tools.description: Create a PDF using a report, proposal, or briefing layout. Provide Markdown or structured sections. Maximum 10 pages. Files expire after 24 hours. Limited trial usage, then 10 cents per document from prepaid credit.

tools.name: tablelift_extract_tables
tools.description: Extract bordered tables from a text-based PDF into CSV and JSON with source page numbers. Maximum 3 MB and 10 pages. Scans and borderless tables are unsupported. Costs 10 cents per document page after the trial allowance; no charge when no useful tables are found.

tools.name: collect_create_form
tools.description: Create a form for 30 days and up to 100 responses. Costs $1 in credits after the trial. Returns a public form link and a private owner token.

tools.name: collect_read_form
tools.description: Read public form questions and availability. Does not expose answers or owner credentials.

tools.name: collect_submit_response
tools.description: Submit answers keyed by question ID to an open form. Text is limited to 2,000 characters per answer and 32 KB total.

tools.name: collect_read_responses
tools.description: Privately retrieve a form and its answers with its owner token.

tools.name: collect_close_form
tools.description: Stop accepting responses. Answers remain privately accessible until expiry.

tools.name: collect_delete_form
tools.description: Delete a form and its responses using the owner token.

tools.name: feedform_normalize_feed
tools.description: Normalize one RSS 2.0 or Atom XML feed to stable JSON. Free; 1 MiB input, up to 100 returned items. Does not fetch URLs or retain feed content.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "collect_read_form" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read public form questions and availability. Does not expose answers or owner credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hookbox_read_inbox, chartlink_get_chart, cleanread_read_page, sourcecheck_check_sources, feedform_normalize_feed · Private data: droplink_publish_document, droplink_read_document, droplink_delete_document, hookbox_create_inbox, hookbox_read_inbox, chartlink_create_chart, printkit_create_pdf, tablelift_extract_tables, collect_create_form, collect_read_form, collect_read_responses, collect_delete_form · Public sink: droplink_publish_document, hookbox_create_inbox, hookbox_read_inbox, hookbox_delete_inbox, collect_submit_response · Destructive: droplink_delete_document, hookbox_delete_inbox, cleanread_read_page, collect_delete_form.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hookbox_read_inbox, chartlink_get_chart, cleanread_read_page, sourcecheck_check_sources, feedform_normalize_feed · Private data: droplink_publish_document, droplink_read_document, droplink_delete_document, hookbox_create_inbox, hookbox_read_inbox, chartlink_create_chart, printkit_create_pdf, tablelift_extract_tables, collect_create_form, collect_read_form, collect_read_responses, collect_delete_form · Public sink: droplink_publish_document, hookbox_create_inbox, hookbox_read_inbox, hookbox_delete_inbox, collect_submit_response · Destructive: droplink_delete_document, hookbox_delete_inbox, cleanread_read_page, collect_delete_form

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
